description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (E-gazette)
reasoning: This gazette content involves the publication of changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRS & LKAS) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes regulatory framework updates and compliance requirements for financial reporting, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
